about: Derivative templates of DESI C_ell^gg against ell, in units of the band-power error sigma_ell = sqrt(C_ii) of the Gaussian covariance, each parameter p in units of its prior width Delta (Delta, not sigma: sigma_v is itself a dispersion): sigma_ell^-1 dC_ell/dp for p = alpha_2/Delta alpha_2 (alpha_2 of the shown bin's group, Delta alpha_2 = 0.5/k_max^2 h^-2 Mpc^2 at the cut) and for p = sigma_v/Delta sigma_v (the shown bin's velocity dispersion and its prior width); and sigma_ell^-1 r_ell with r_ell = dC_ell/d(alpha_2/Delta alpha_2) - sum_g c_g dC_ell/d(sigma_v,g/Delta sigma_v,g), the leftover after the best combination c of all sigma_v, fitted over the whole data vector in the C^-1 metric on the bands the cut keeps (redundancy_f is the fraction of the alpha_2 information that combination reproduces). The stored arrays are per unit alpha_2 and sigma_v (dC_dalpha2, dC_dsigma_v, residual_per_unit_alpha2), with the widths alongside. Written by EXAMPLE_EVALUATE_FISHER_MODEL.ipynb (section 11, final-tier caches); the bins are the BGS bin nearest the middle of the sample that keeps a band at k_max = 0.075 (the thin low-redshift BGS bins keep none; on a tie, the one keeping more bands), the middle bin of the LRG sample, and that bin's cross spectrum with the next LRG bin (bins numbered from 0 as in the dataset's bin table). cut_ell: where the kept bands end at the cut (k_max at z = 0, each bin cut at k_max/D(zbar_i), intersected with the shipped mask), with kept_bands_end_by naming what ends them.
